title: Northfield State University — RFQ for A/E Services, Science Building Renovation
notes: Authored for this evaluation to mirror common solicitation structures; not a real procurement.

requirements.quote: Fee information must not be included in the submittal
Statements of Qualifications are due by 3:00 p.m. Central Time on September 3, 2026
Submit one (1) original and five (5) copies, plus one electronic copy on a USB drive
Submittals shall use Standard Form 330, Parts I and II
The SF 330 Part I, Section H, shall not exceed ten (10) pages
Firms must be licensed to practice architecture in the State of Northfield
The engineer of record for each discipline must hold a Northfield professional engineering license
maintain professional liability insurance of at least $2,000,000 per claim
Provide resumes of key personnel, including the principal-in-charge, project architect, and lead mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineers
Provide up to ten example projects; at least three must be renovations of occupied laboratory or science buildings
Describe your approach to phasing construction in an occupied building
describe your quality control process for construction documents
disclose any current or pending litigation related to professional services within the last five years
Include a completed Disclosure of Lobbying Activities form (SF-LLL), if applicable
Past performance on schedule and budget (15%)
Familiarity with the University's design standards (5%)

traps.quote: The University will provide existing building drawings to the selected firm
traps.why: Obligation or right of the owner, not the bidder
